explanation: An area in the ancient Middle East that God promised to give to the children of Israel, later known as the land of Israel.
Persons sent out to explore and gather information about a specific region or people, in this case Canaan.
A description or account of a situation or event, here the spies' feedback concerning Canaan.
An attempt to resist or defy authority, in this case against Moses and Aaron.
A consequence or response to actions considered unacceptable, here God's punishment for the rebellion.
The time the children of Israel had to wander in the wilderness before they could enter Canaan.
One of the two faithful spies who gave a positive report about Canaan and who later led the children of Israel into the land.
The other faithful spy who gave a positive report about Canaan and who was also a central figure during the conquest of the land.
